comparators.chosen_on: dev streams 9001-9004 (E contract, alias+compose mean utility): strongest conventional pipeline lat_aopt 0.8325; GBM best 0.827; same-library exploit 0.833 is used for the acquisition-rule isolation

lifecycle.promotion: gain >= eps_val and wins > losses and wins >= 2 on cells not used in the candidate fit

margin.kind: engineering threshold on absolute shortlist utility (mean realized activity of the 5 nominated pairs)
margin.rationale: Chosen before scoring as the smallest gain that would justify maintaining a program library and a decision-value acquisition rule: about one read-noise standard deviation (0.01-0.014) of the synthetic measurements and about 0.3x the dev-measured no-probe-to-oracle gap. It is not a fraction of oracle headroom and was not tuned on evaluation streams.

stats.rule: SUPPORT if lower bound >= margin; NO_SUPPORT if upper bound < margin; else INCONCLUSIVE

streams.generators: iv_worlds.make_stream (N_DRUGS=28, 8 H0 + 4x4 task cells + 4 A_old + 4 A_new; nuisance 0.01 drug-cell, 0.01 read noise, 0.02 pair mean; gate amplitude 0.14-0.24)

task.fo_probe_rule: seeded random stratified-free draw from the legal probe half
task.transfer_mask: every second pair within each class is a legal probe; the rest is the target pool
